c428396 HELD ON ONE FORMATTING LINE. Everything else passes and I verified the hard part myself.

  align/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/align/CostSuite.scala isn't formatted properly

Run scalafmtAll -- not scalafmtCheck, which is the COMPILE config and cannot see a Test source.
That is the same trap that parked D1 for three hours this afternoon.

EVERYTHING ELSE IS GREEN:
  alignJVM, codecJVM, fixturesJVM, lawsJVM, embedBench, embedGrakern, interviewJVM
  708 tests, seven totals counted, GATE_EXIT=0, zero errors, merged tree off current main.
  No holds on the board. My index is clean.

AND I CHECKED THE CRITERION I SET, RATHER THAN TAKING THE REPORT. I ruled accounting-only, with
the test of success being that NO FIXTURE NUMBER MOVES. The golden re-cut worried me because
hsmm-v3-wog.json is a new artifact, so I extracted every `total` from the v2 and v3 goldens and
compared them:

  v2 25,960 bytes / v3 26,284 bytes / delta 324
  18 total-values in each
  IDENTICAL: TRUE

Every cost is byte-identical. The golden grew by the added field and nothing else. THAT IS EXACTLY
THE RULING SATISFIED -- the record now distinguishes a measured semantic distance from an imputed
one, and not one price moved.

The v2-to-v3 bump is right for the same reason v1-to-v2 was: a required field changed the wire
shape, so the version must move or it carries no information. Same reasoning, second instance,
and you applied it without being told this time.

Fix the one file, push, and I will merge on the new SHA. Nothing else outstanding.
